oxford.name: University of Oxford
oxford.pg_deadline: Set per course; main funding deadlines Dec/Jan – see course page

cambridge.name: University of Cambridge
cambridge.pg_fee: Fee applies to most courses – see course page
cambridge.pg_deadline: 2027 entry: applications open 9 Sep 2026; funding deadline 8 Dec 2026 (most courses); course deadlines vary
cambridge.scholarship: Gates Cambridge (funding deadline 8 Dec 2026 for most applicants)

ucl.name: University College London (UCL)
ucl.pg_fee: £90 most taught Master's (£160 some School of Management MScs); no fee for research degrees
ucl.chat_note: UCL runs Unibuddy chat per faculty (e.g. Computer Science, Life Sciences, IOE)
ucl.society: Indian Society: https://studentsunionucl.org/clubs-societies/indian-society | Bangla Society (Students' Union UCL)

imperial.name: Imperial College London
imperial.pg_fee: £90 Master's (£125 Business School MSc); no fee for PhD; waivers for financial hardship (2027-28)

kcl.name: King's College London
kcl.pg_fee: Fee applies (amount on 'How to apply' page)
kcl.pg_deadline: 2027 entry example (Physics MSc): first deadline 9 Mar 2027; international final deadline 25 Jul 2027
kcl.chat_note: Offer-holder subject pages include chats with students

manchester.name: University of Manchester
manchester.pg_fee: No application fee mentioned; £2,500 deposit for self-funded international offer holders
manchester.pg_deadline: Staged admissions with several selection deadlines during the year

warwick.name: University of Warwick
warwick.pg_fee: £75 for taught courses; no fee for research degrees

bristol.name: University of Bristol
bristol.pg_fee: £60 only for Business School and Economics taught Master's (2027/28); waiver for nationals of medium/low HDI countries (India and Bangladesh are medium HDI – check)

glasgow.name: University of Glasgow
glasgow.pg_fee: £25 may be charged for some programmes
glasgow.pg_deadline: Six application rounds per cycle; places may become limited from 16 December

southampton.name: University of Southampton
southampton.pg_fee: No application fee mentioned; £2,000 deposit for international students
southampton.pg_deadline: On each course page; may close early for some countries – apply early
southampton.society: Indian Society: https://www.susu.org/groups/indiasoc | Bangla Society: https://susu.org/groups/bangla-society

nottingham.name: University of Nottingham
nottingham.pg_fee: Some courses charge a fee (shown when applying)
nottingham.pg_deadline: International (2026/27 entry): taught 3 Aug 2026, research 17 Aug 2026; 2027/28 dates to be confirmed

sheffield.name: University of Sheffield
sheffield.scholarship: International Postgraduate Scholarship 2027: £7,000 off tuition, automatic, for India (not Bangladesh); accept offer by 6 Jul 2027

birmingham.name: University of Birmingham
birmingham.pg_fee: No application fee for taught courses
birmingham.pg_deadline: Sept 2027 entry: most taught courses 2 Jul 2027; deposit by 30 Jul 2027

qmul.name: Queen Mary University of London
qmul.pg_deadline: Overseas: 14 Dec 2026 for January 2027 start; Sept 2027 dates not yet published (Sept 2026 was 1 Sep 2026)
qmul.scholarship: Global Excellence Scholarship £8,000 (first-class degree; rolling from Oct 2026)

durham.name: Durham University
durham.scholarship: Inspiring Excellence £5,000 or £10,000 (overseas, self-funded); rounds 7 Dec 2026, 15 Mar 2027, 1 May 2027

newcastle.name: Newcastle University
newcastle.scholarship: India Future Leaders Scholarship £10,000 (automatic; accept offer and pay deposit by 2 Aug 2027); VC International £8,000 open to Bangladesh too
newcastle.chat_note: Business School chat; other schools vary

coventry.name: Coventry University
coventry.pg_deadline: Most courses have several start dates a year (up to six)

tum.name: Technical University of Munich (TUM)
tum.pg_deadline: Master's: 31 May (winter semester), 30 Nov (summer semester); some programmes differ
tum.pg_tuition: Non-EU: Master's usually €4,000 or €6,000 per semester (rising to €4,600/€6,800 from WS 2027/28)

lmu.name: LMU Munich
lmu.pg_tuition: No general tuition for international students (some programmes charge, e.g. PPE €5,250/semester)

rwth.name: RWTH Aachen University
rwth.pg_deadline: Master's: 1 Mar (winter, admission-free) / 15 Jul (winter, restricted); 1 Sep / 15 Jan (summer)
rwth.pg_tuition: No tuition fee for non-EU (semester contribution only)
rwth.society: Association of Indian Students Aachen (AISA): https://www.aisa.rwth-aachen.de/

tuberlin.name: TU Berlin
tuberlin.pg_deadline: Master's: 15 Jun (winter, restricted) / 31 Aug (winter, admission-free); 15 Jan / 28 Feb (summer)
tuberlin.pg_fee: Many international applications go via uni-assist (€75 first, €30 each additional)

kth.name: KTH Royal Institute of Technology
kth.pg_deadline: Autumn 2027: apply 16 Oct 2026 – 15 Jan 2027; documents and fee by 1 Feb 2027

mit.name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)
mit.pg_fee: Set by each programme; international applicants can't get hardship waivers
mit.pg_deadline: Mostly December for fall entry – check programme page

stanford.name: Stanford University
stanford.pg_deadline: e.g. GSE 2027-28: PhD 16 Nov 2026; MA/MS 7 Jan 2027

cmu.name: Carnegie Mellon University
cmu.pg_fee: e.g. Information Networking Institute: $75 (waived if you attend an info session)
cmu.pg_deadline: e.g. INI Fall 2027: priority 1 Dec 2026, final 29 Jan 2027

purdue.name: Purdue University
purdue.pg_deadline: e.g. Engineering (ACS) Fall: priority 15 Jan, final 31 Jul

toronto.name: University of Toronto
toronto.pg_fee: CAD 130 (programmes starting Sep 2026–May 2027); CAD 135 (from Sep 2027); no waivers; some programmes add a supplementary fee
toronto.pg_deadline: Set by each programme – check the programme page

mcgill.name: McGill University
mcgill.pg_fee: About CAD 137 (Fall 2025 figure; check current fee)
mcgill.pg_deadline: Varies by department, e.g. Pathology: 15 Jan (Fall), 1 Aug (Winter) for international applicants

ubc.name: University of British Columbia (UBC)
ubc.pg_fee: Fee shown in the application portal; waived for citizens of the UN least developed countries (includes Bangladesh, not India)

waterloo.name: University of Waterloo
waterloo.pg_deadline: Set by each programme; apply 2–4 weeks before it

alberta.name: University of Alberta
alberta.pg_deadline: Varies by department, e.g. Cell Biology: 1 Jun (Sep start), 1 Oct (Jan start)

melbourne.name: University of Melbourne
melbourne.pg_fee: AUD 154 per application (waivers only in listed cases, e.g. full sponsorship)
melbourne.pg_deadline: Closing dates on each course's 'How to apply' tab

sydney.name: University of Sydney
sydney.pg_deadline: Semester 1, 2027: generally 18 Dec 2026 for international postgraduates (some courses differ)

monash.name: Monash University
monash.pg_fee: AUD 125 for international applicants applying directly (waiver codes at Monash events)

anu.name: Australian National University (ANU)
anu.pg_deadline: Semester 1, 2027: 15 Dec 2026 (Crawford School: 31 Oct 2026); Semester 2, 2027: 15 May 2027

khalifa.name: Khalifa University
khalifa.scholarship: Graduate scholarships for international applicants cover tuition and include a monthly allowance – confirm amounts and deadlines on ku.ac.ae

uaeu.name: United Arab Emirates University (UAEU)
uaeu.pg_deadline: Published each year by the College of Graduate Studies (cgs@uaeu.ac.ae)

aus.name: American University of Sharjah (AUS)
aus.pg_tuition: 2026–27 master's: AED 4,371 per credit hour (Arts and Sciences) or AED 5,480 (Engineering, Business, Architecture)

hwdubai.name: Heriot-Watt University Dubai
hwdubai.pg_tuition: Shown on each programme page; UK degree taught in Dubai

UK.ug_deadline: 13 Jan 2027, 6pm UK (main); 15 Oct 2026 for Oxford, Cambridge, medicine, dentistry, veterinary (passed); final 23 Sep 2027

Germany.ug_route: Directly to the university or via uni-assist (VPD), depending on the university
Germany.ug_fee: uni-assist: €75 first university, €30 each additional (status Oct 2025)
Germany.ug_deadline: Typically 15 July (winter semester) / 15 January (summer semester); check each programme
Germany.tuition: Free in most states (Berlin, NRW). Bavaria: TUM charges non-EU (Master's €4,000–6,000/semester; rising for WS 2027/28). Baden-Württemberg: €1,500/semester for non-EU. Everyone pays a semester contribution (~€300–400).

Sweden.ug_fee: SEK 900 for non-EU/EEA applicants, no waivers
Sweden.ug_deadline: Master's starting autumn 2027: applications open 16 Oct 2026, deadline 15 Jan 2027; documents and fee by 1 Feb 2027
Sweden.tuition: Non-EU/EEA students pay tuition; see each university's fee page

USA.ug_route: Common App or the university's own portal
USA.ug_fee: Set by each university (many charge $75–$90; 500+ colleges charge no fee to international applicants)
USA.ug_deadline: Usually Early Action/Decision 1 Nov, Regular Decision 1–15 Jan

Canada.ug_route: Apply directly to each university (Ontario universities through OUAC)
Canada.ug_fee: Application fees are usually about CAD 100–160
Canada.ug_deadline: Most undergraduate deadlines fall between November and February for September entry
Canada.tuition: Most new students also need a Provincial Attestation Letter; from 1 Jan 2026 master's and PhD students at public universities are exempt

Australia.ug_fee: Application fees are usually about AUD 100–155
Australia.ug_deadline: Two main intakes: February/March (Semester 1) and July (Semester 2)
Australia.tuition: Tuition is charged per year and varies by course; see each course page

UAE.ug_fee: Application fees vary (e.g. Heriot-Watt Dubai AED 525)
UAE.ug_deadline: Most universities admit in autumn and spring
UAE.tuition: Many Dubai universities are branch campuses of UK, Australian or Indian universities; check that the degree is recognised where you want to work
